job.location: Walnut Valley Unified School District, CA

items.item_text: 01. How many year's of paid or volunteer experience do you have in a liscenced children's center, preschool-aged enrichment program, or comparable child care program? Options: Less than one year experience | More than one year experience
02. Do you meet the educational requirement of a high school diploma or equivalent? Options: Yes | No
03. Have you completed at least 12-semester units (4 classes) in early childhood education or child development? Options: Yes | No

Utilize a variety of teaching methodologies and strategies and activities such as singing, dance, rhythm, and arts and crafts to instruct a wide range of students based on their developmental, physical, and emotional maturity
Prepare appropriate educational development plans for students
Utilize informal and formal assessments and exercises to evaluate student skill levels

Maintain a clean, organized, and safe environment by performing housekeeping tasks, checking equipment and grounds for safety, and reporting any concerns or faulty equipment that do not meet safety standards
Plan and implement a variety of physical activities to develop student gross and fine motor skills
Provide routine first aid, contact Preschool Site Supervisor, families, police, fire, and emergency medical services as required
Guide children with self-care, hygiene, and toileting needs, which includes diapering children
May assist, prepare, and distribute snacks or meals
May administer pre-authorized medication under specific guidelines and direction
Complete and maintain a variety of records and files, including confidential student records and medical information

Plan, design, and provide meaningful learning and developmental activities for preschool classes, including a program of instruction designed to enhance developmental, emotional, and physical capabilities of students
Plan, coordinate, and maintain a supportive learning environment independently by working collaboratively with co-workers to develop lessons and learning activities
Deliver education by using effective oral communication skills and provide students with clearly communicated instructions
Create a positive, supportive, and inclusive preschool classroom that promotes teamwork and collaboration among staff, students, and families
Participate in professional development opportunities offered by department, school site, and District that are held during employee’s work hours and work year
May participate in professional development opportunities outside employee’s work hours and work year
Perform related duties as assigned
Effectively receive and deliver communication in oral and written formats
Maintain appropriate records and prepare complete and concise reports
Operate basic computer, program software, and other electronic devices
Goals, principles, and practices for implementing age-appropriate child development and guidance in a preschool environment
Play-based learning to assist children with individual and group activities
Child mobility, cognition, and learning styles
Mathematic, grammar, spelling, language, and reading to direct students with learning exercises or projects
Communication methods that promote patience and sensitivity when interacting with students, staff, and families
Equity, access, and inclusion practices as it relates to all program participants
Plan and implement an effective and efficient preschool instructional program
Provide effective learning activities for children experiencing a wide range of socioeconomic and cultural backgrounds and exhibiting varying levels of intellectual, social, and emotional maturity
Effectively assess educational needs of children and implement appropriate and sound instructional plans and activities
Provide a warm, attractive, and inviting learning environment
Perform routine classroom-related clerical tasks and operate a variety of educational and office-related machines, equipment, and technology
Work courteously and tactfully with co-workers, students, and families
Adapt easily to work assignments, additional priorities, and new procedures
Receive constructive feedback and modify work and behaviors appropriately
Prioritize and identify needs and solve problems independently as appropriate
Suggest improvements to Preschool Site Supervisor as appropriate
Skillfully handle difficult situations using good judgment and tact
Maintain a high level of professionalism and promote an environment of belonging
Establish and maintain positive and effective working relationships
Receive constructive criticism and modify work appropriately
Demonstrate cultural competence and responsiveness in interactions, decision-making, communication, and processes
Efficiently use and manage time and meet deadlines
